paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation:
This plot illustrates the relative change in performance when applying layer-wise quantized pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct across different layer groups, comparing various token-precision configurations against a baseline. The x-axis is categorical, representing five layer groups labeled "Layer1-4," "Layer5-12," "Layer13-20," "Layer21-28," and "Layer29-32." The y-axis represents "Relative Change" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately −25% to +5%, with gridlines and tick labels at 5% intervals (5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, −25%).

A gray dashed horizontal line represents the baseline of 4×tokens at 4-bit precision, fixed at 0% relative change across all layer groups. A yellow-orange solid line with circular markers represents "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit," which starts near 0% at Layer1-4, remains close to 0% through Layer5-12 and Layer13-20 (dipping only slightly to approximately −1%), stays near 0% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0% at Layer29-32. A red solid line with square markers represents "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit," which begins near 0% at Layer1-4, drops to approximately −4.5% at Layer5-12, reaches its lowest point of approximately −5% at Layer13-20, recovers to approximately −1.5% at Layer21-28, and returns to approximately −1% at Layer29-32. A light blue solid line with circular markers represents "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit," which starts at approximately −1.5% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately −2.5% at Layer5-12, drops sharply to approximately −13% at Layer13-20, recovers to approximately −2% at Layer21-28, and ends at approximately −1% at Layer29-32. A dark blue solid line with square markers represents "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit," which begins at approximately −3% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately −4.5% at Layer5-12, drops steeply to its minimum of approximately −25.5% at Layer13-20, recovers to approximately −5.5% at Layer21-28, and ends at approximately −3.5% at Layer29-32. All four non-baseline lines exhibit their most negative values at the Layer13-20 group, with varying degrees of decline and recovery across the layer groups.
